title: Proposal Document Completeness — UDM Output
description: JSON contract for the near-final document-completeness review of a proposal package. Captures the as-found inventory, sponsor requirements, and the gap analysis (per requirement and per person), with explicit boolean flags that downstream UDM ingest can use to populate Proposal, Personnel, and Subaward records.

sponsor_name.description: Sponsor agency name. Resolves to UDM Sponsor_Organization.

proposal_track_type.description: Proposal track type that may trigger additional requirements (e.g., 'TTP-P', 'standard').

review_type.description: Review pathway selected for this proposal.

senior_key_personnel.description: Senior key personnel as identified in the proposal. Resolves to UDM Personnel.

budget_personnel.description: Personnel identified from the budget document. Used to cross-check against senior_key_personnel.

has_postdocs_or_grad_students.description: True iff the budget includes postdoctoral or graduate-student personnel lines.

has_subawards.description: True iff the proposal includes subaward(s). Resolves to UDM Subaward presence.

uploaded_documents.description: Flat list of documents currently uploaded in the proposal package.

required_for.description: Whom the document is required for (e.g., 'all proposals', 'each senior key person', 'each subawardee').

conditional_requirements.description: Documents required only when a condition is met (e.g., mentoring plan when has_postdocs_or_grad_students).

per_person_required_documents.description: Document names required per senior key person (typically: biosketch, current & pending, collaboration & affiliation, synergistic activities).

per_person_document_matrix.description: Per-person matrix of the four required documents. One row per senior key person.

subaward_documents.description: Per-subawardee matrix of required subaward documents. Empty array when has_subawards is false.

personnel_discrepancies.description: Discrepancies between budget personnel and senior-key-personnel listings (duplicates, missing entries, name mismatches).

prioritized_missing.description: Ordered list of missing items to ask the PI about, ranked by severity (compliance-critical first).
